Item.Value: SELECT * FROM DP_RM_List as List LEFT OUTER JOIN DP_RM_Category as Cate ON List.CompanyID = Cate.CompanyID AND List.CategoryID = Cate.CategoryID WHERE List.CompanyID = {0} AND List.ActiveUse = 1 AND List.UsableQty > 0 ORDER BY List.CompanyID, List.CategoryID, List.ListOrder , List.WriteDate desc

SELECT RL.* , DC.DeptBase, DC.DeptKo, DC.DeptEn, DC.DeptJa, DC.DeptFr, DC.DeptZhcn, DC.DeptZhtw, DC.DeptManyName , DC.TitleBase, DC.TitleKo, DC.TitleEn, DC.TitleJa, DC.TitleFr, DC.TitleZhcn, DC.TitleZhtw, DC.TitleManyName , DC.DutyBase, DC.DutyKo, DC.DutyEn, DC.DutyJa, DC.DutyFr, DC.DutyZhcn, DC.DutyZhtw, DC.DutyManyName FROM VW_RM_ReserveList RL WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DP_COM_DeptCode AS DC WITH(NOLOCK) ON RL.CompanyID = DC.CompanyID AND RL.DeptCodeID = DC.DeptCodeID WHERE RL.CompanyID = {0} AND RL.ReservationID = {1}

SELECT L.CompanyID ,L.ListID ,L.ListUserID ,L.ManagerUserID ,L.ManagerName ,L.Gubun ,AU.NameBase, AU.NameKo, AU.NameEn, AU.NameJa , AU.NameFr, AU.NameZhcn ,AU.NameZhtw, AU.ManyName ,AU.DeptBase ,AU.DeptKo,AU.DeptEn,AU.DeptJa,AU.DeptFr ,AU.DeptZhCn,AU.DeptZhTw,AU.ManyDeptName,AU.TitleBase ,AU.TitleKo,AU.TitleEn,AU.TitleJa,AU.TitleFr,AU.TitleZhCn ,AU.TitleZhTw,AU.ManyTitleName, AU.MailID, AU.MailDomain, AU.MobilePhone FROM DP_RM_ListUser AS L LEFT OUTER JOIN VW_UserInfo AS AU ON L.CompanyID = AU.CompanyID AND L.ManagerUserID = AU.UserID WHERE L.CompanyID = {0} AND L.ListID = {1} AND AU.BaseDept=1

SELECT Count(*) FROM DP_RM_List WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = {0} AND ActiveUse = 1 AND ListID in (SELECT ListID FROM DP_RM_ListUser WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = {0} AND ManagerUserID={1} AND Gubun = '1')
